notes.growth_5y_note: growth_5y (+350%) refers to the AI-driven Knowledge Management subsegment, estimated from ~$2.5B in 2021 to $11.24B in 2026. The broader KM software market (all vendors) grew approximately +75% over the same period. The AI-specific CAGR is sourced from Research and Markets / Straits Research analytics; exact 2021 baseline is an estimate.
notes.growth_1y_note: growth_1y (+46%) is sourced from the AI-driven KM segment: $7.71B (2025) to $11.24B (2026) at a 46.2% CAGR, per market research synthesis.
notes.growth_3m_note: growth_3m (+14%) is an estimated figure based on EU AI Act enforcement deadline momentum and enterprise procurement acceleration in Q2–Q3 2026. No single published source confirmed this exact 3-month figure.
notes.market_share_note: Market share percentages are estimates synthesized from multiple analyst reports. Big Tech (Microsoft + Google) holds approximately 60%+ combined. Individual vendor shares for Atlassian, Notion, and Glean are derived from ARR comparisons and analyst commentary, not official reported market share data.
notes.search_volume_note: 130,000 estimated combined monthly searches across 'knowledge management software', 'AI knowledge management', 'enterprise knowledge management', and 'second brain app' keyword clusters (US + global, August 2026 estimate).
